G2700.def:
κατα-τοξεύω
[in LXX: Êx 19:13 (יָרָה), al. ;]
to strike down with an arrow, shoot dead: Hb 12:20 (LXX) (Rec.; WH, R, om.).†
(AS)

G2701.def:
κατα-τρέχω
[in LXX: Lv 26:37, Jz 1:6 (רָדַף), al. ;]
to run down: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), At 21:32.†
(AS)

G2702.def:
κατα-φέρω
[in LXX for יָרַד hi., etc. ;]
to bring down: αἰτιώματα, At 25:7; ψῆφον, to cast a ballot, At 26:10; pass., to be borne down: ὕπνῳ, ἀπὸ τ. ὕ., At 20:9.†
(AS)

G2703.def:
κατα-φεύγω
[in LXX for נוּס, etc. ;]
to flee for refuge: before εἰς, At 14:6; metaphorically, with inf., Hb 6:18.†
(AS)

G2704.def:
κατα-φθείρω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת hi., Gn 6:12, al. ;]
__1 1 to destroy entirely.
__2. In moral sense (as LXX), to deprave, corrupt: pass. pf. ptcp., before τ. νο ν, 2Tm 3:8.†
(AS)

G2705.def:
κατα-φιλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָשַׁק ;]
to kiss fervently, kiss affectionately: Mt 26:49, Mc 14:45, Lc 7:38, 45 15:20, At 20:37.†
(AS)

G2706.def:
κατα-φρονέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for בָּגַד, בּוּז, etc. ;]
to think little of, despise: with genitive, Mt 6:24 18:10, Lc 16:13, Rm 2:4, 1Co 11:22, 1Tm 4:12 6:2, Hb 12:2, 2Pe 2:10.†
(AS)

G2707.def:
κατα-φρονητής, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for בָּגַד, בֹּגְדוֹת, Hc 1:5 2:5, Sf 3:4 * ;]
a despiser: At 13:41.†
(AS)

G2708.def:
κατα-χέω
[in LXX for יָצַק, נָטָה, עָטָה hi. ;]
to pour down upon: with genitive (cl.), Mc 14:3; before ἐπί, with genitive, Mt 26:7.†
(AS)

G2709.def:
κατα-χθόνιος, -ον
(χθών, the earth),
subterranean, under the earth (in cl., of the infernal gods): of the departed in Hades, opposite to ἐπουράνιος, ἐπίγειος, Fp 2:10.†
(AS)

G2710.def:
κατα-χράομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX: Ep. Je.28, 3Ma.4:5 3Mac 5:22 * ;]
to make full use of, use to the uttermost, use up: 1Co 7:31; with dative, 1Co 9:18 (for other senses, see LS, see word)..†
(AS)

G2711.def:
κατα-ψύχω
[in LXX: Gn 18:4 (שָׁעַן ni.)* ;]
to cool: with accusative, Lc 16:24.†
(AS)

G2713.def:
κατέναντι
adv., [in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶד, פָּנִים, Gn 7:1, etc. ;]
over against, opposite, before: ἡ, κ. κώμη, Lc 19:30; as prep., with genitive, Mt 21:2 27:24 (ἀπ-, WH, mg.), Mc 11:2 12:41 (ἀπ-, WH, mg.) Mc 13:3; metaphorically, before, before θεοῦ, Rm 4:17, 2Co 2:17 12:19.†
(AS)

G2714.def:
κατενώπιον
adv. (= Hom., κατένωπα), [in LXX: Sl 44:15, al. ;]
over against, before: with genitive, τ. δόξης, Ju 24; metaphorically (cf. κατέναντι, and see Lft., Col., l.with), τ. θεοῦ, Ef 1:4, Cl 1:22.†
(AS)

G2715.def:
κατ-εξουσιάζω
to exercise authority over: with genitive of person(s), Mt 20:25, Mc 10:42.†
SYN: (κατακυριεύω) (see Swete, Mk., l.with)
(AS)

G2716.def:
κατ-εργάζομαι
(emphatic form of ἐργάζομαι), [in LXX for פָּעַל, etc. (9 exx., each for a different Heb. word) ;]
to effect by labour, achieve, work out, bring about: with accusative, Rm 4:15 5:3 7:8, 15-20, 2Co 7:10, Ef 6:13, Tg 1:3; pass., 2Co 12:12; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Rm 7:13, 2Co 4:17 7:11 9:11; id. before διά, with genitive of person(s), Rm 15:18; τ. σωτηρίαν, Fp 2:12; with accusative of person(s) before εἰς, 2Co 5:5 (RV, wrought); of evil deeds, Rm 1:27 2:9, 1Co 5:3, 1Pe 4:3.†
(AS)

G2718.def:
κατ-έρχομαι
[in LXX: Tob.1:22, א Tob.2:1, Et 3:13, Wis.11:22, 2Ma.11:29 * ;]
to come down, go down: before εἰς, Lc 4:31, At 8:5 13:4 15:30 19:1, Τ; ἀπό, Lc 9:37, At 15:1 18:5 21:10; ἀπό and εἰς, At 11:27 12:10; of coming to port by ship, At 18:22 21:3 27:5; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), At 9:32; metaphorically, of gifts from God, Tg 3:15.†
(AS)

G2719.def:
κατ-εσθίω
("perfective" comp. of ἐσθίω, which see, and cf. M, Pr., 111) [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל ;]
to eat up, devour: with accusative, of seed, Mt 13:4, Mc 4:4, Lc 8:5; τέκνον, Ap 12:4; βιβλαρίδιον, Ap 10:9-10; metaphorically, οἰκίας, Mt 23:13, Mc 12:40, Lc 20:47; τ. βίον, Lc 15:30; with accusative of person(s), Jo 2:17 (LXX), 2Co 11:20, Gl 5:15, Ap 11:5 20:9.†
(AS)

G2720.def:
κατ-ευθύνω
[in LXX for כּוּן ni., hi., etc. ;]
to make or keep straight, direct, guide: metaphorically, τ. ὁδόν, 1Ts 3:11; τ. πόδας εἰς ὁδὸν εἰρήνης, Lc 1:79; τ. καρδίας εἰς τ. ἀγάπην, 2Ts 3:5.†
(AS)

G2722.def:
κατ-έχω
[in LXX for אָחַז, חָזַק hi., etc. ;]
__1. perfective of ἔχω (M, Pr., 116; M, Th., 155),
__(a) to possess, hold fast: Lc 8:15, Jo 5:4, Rm 1:18 (Lft., Notes, 251), 1Co 7:30 11:2, 2Co 6:10, 1Ts 5:21, Hb 3:6, 14 10:23;
__(b) to lay hold of, get possession of: Lc 14:9.
__2. to hold back, detain, restrain (M, Th., 156 f.): with accusative before τοῦ μή with inf., Lc 4:42; before πρός, with accusative, Phm 13; absol., τὸ κατέχον (ὁ κ.), 2Ts 2:6-7.
__3. Intrans., as nautical term, to put in, make for (LS, see word): At 27:40.†
(AS)

G2723.def:
κατηγορέω, -ῶ
(κατά, ἀγορεύω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 6:5, (9), 1Ma.7:6 1Mac 7:25, 2Ma.4:47 2Mac 10:13 2Mac 10:21, 4Ma.9:14 * ;]
to make accusation, accuse,
__(a) in general: absol., Rm 2:15; with genitive of person(s) (cl., WM, 254), Jo 5:45; irreg. with accusative of person(s), Ap 12:10;
__(b) before a judge: absol., At 24:2, 19; with genitive of person(s), Mt 12:10, Mc 3:2, Lc 6:7 11:54 (WH, txt., R, om.), Lc 23:2, 10, Jo 8:6 At 25:5 28:19; id. with accusative of thing(s) (cl., but see WM, l.with), Mc 15:3-4; with genitive of thing(s) (Dem.), At 24:8 25:11; before περί, with genitive of thing(s) (Thuc., viii, 85), At 24:13; with accusative of thing(s), before κατά with genitive of person(s) (WM, § 28, 1), Lc 23:14. Pass. (B1., § 54, 3), before ὑπό with genitive, Mt 27:12, At 22:30; ὁ κατηγορούμενος, At 25:16.†
(AS)

G2724.def:
κατηγορία, -ας, ἡ
(κατήγορος),
an accusation, charge: with genitive of person(s), Jo 18:29; before κατά, with id., 1Tm 5:19; with genitive of thing(s), Tt 1:6.†
(AS)

G2725.def:
κατήγορος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Pv 18:17 (רִיב), 2Ma.4:5 * ;]
an accuser: At 23:30, 35 24:8 (WH, R, txt. om.) At 25:16, 18.†
(AS)

G2727.def:
κατ-ηχέω, -ῶ
__1. to resound.
__2. to teach by word of mouth, instruct, inform (see 131., Phil. Gosp., 20, 31): Gl 6:6; with accusative of person(s), 1Co 14:19; pass. with accusative of thing(s), Lc 1:4 (ICC, in l), At 18:25 21:24 (cf. Lk, l.with), Gl 6:6; before κ, with genitive of thing(s), Rm 2:18; περί, with genitive of person(s), At 21:21.†
(AS)

G2728.def:
κατ-ιόω, -ῶ
(intensive of ἰόω; ἰός) [in LXX: Sir.12:11 * ;]
to rust over; pass., become rusted over: Tg 5:3.†
(AS)

G2729.def:
κατ-ισχύω
[in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;]
to overpower, prevail against, prevail: absol., Lc 23:23; with inf., Lc 21:36; with genitive, Mt 16:18.†
(AS)

G2730.def:
κατ-οικέω, -ῶ
[in LXX very frequently and nearly always for יָשַׁב ;]
__1. trans., to inhabit, dwell in: with accusative, Lc 13:4, At 1:10 2:9, 14 4:16 9:32, 35 19:10, 17. Ap 17:2; of God, Mt 23:21.
__2. Intrans., to settle, dwell: At 22:12; before ἐν (cl.), At 1:20 (LXX) At 2:5 7:2, 4 7:48 9:22 11:29 13:27 17:24, Hb 11:9, Ap 13:12; before εἰς (B1., § 39, 3; M, Pr., 62 f., 234 f.), Mt 2:23 4:13, At 7:4; ἐπὶ τ. γῆς (Nm 13:33, al.), Ap 3:10 6:10 8:13 11:10 13:8, 14 17:8; ἐπὶ παντὸς προσώπου τ. γ., At 17:26; ὅπου, Ap 2:13; ἐκεῖ (of demons), Mt 12:45, Lc 11:26. Metaphorical, of divine indwelling: ὁ Χριστός, Ef 3:17; τ. πνεῦμα, Tg 4:5 (κατῴκισεν, T, WH, R, txt.); τ. πλήωρμα (τ. θεότητος), Cl 1:19 2:9; δικαιοσύνη (cf. Wis.1:4), 2Pe 3:13 (cf. ἐν-κατοικέω).†
κατοικίζω,
[in LXX for יָשַׁב hi., etc. ;]
to cause to dwell: metaphorically, with accusative, τὸ πνεῦμα, Tg 4:5 (Rec., R, mg., κατῴκησεν).†
(AS)

G2731.def:
κατ-οίκησις, -εως, ἡ
(κατοικέω), [in LXX for יָשַׁב, Gn 10:30, al. ;]
dwelling: Mc 5:3.†
(AS)

G2732.def:
κατ-οικητήριον, -ου, τό
(κατοικέω), [in LXX for מוֹשָׁב, מָעוֹן, etc. ;]
a habitation, dwelling-place: Ef 2:22, Ap 18:2.†
(AS)

G2733.def:
κατ-οικία, -ας, ἡ
(κατοικέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹשָׁב, Êx 35:3, al. ;]
__1. a dwelling: At 17:26.
__2. a settlement (Polyb.).†
(AS)

G2734.def:
κατοπτρίζω
(κάτοπτρον, a mirror),
to show as in a mirror. Mid., to see oneself mirrored (see MM, Exp., xv); with accusative of thing(s) (R, txt., but see mg.), to reflect as a mirror: 2Co 3:18 (cf. Abbott, Essays, 94).†
(AS)

G2736.def:
κάτω
adv. (κατά), [in LXX for מַטָּה, תַּחַת and cogn. forms ;]
__1. down, downwards (with verbs of motion), Mt 4:6, Lc 4:9, Jo 8:6, 8, At 20:9.
__2. below, beneath: Mc 14:66, At 2:19" (LXX) ; ἕως κ. (Eze.1:27, al.), Mt 27:51, Mc 15:38. τὰ κ. (opposite to τ. ἄνω), Jo 8:23. Compar. κατωτέρω: ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κ. (cf. 1Cr 27:21), Mt 2:16.†
(AS)

G2737.def:
κατώτερος, -έρα, -ερον
(κάτω), [in LXX for תַּחְתּוֹן, תַּחְתִּי ;]
lower; τὰ. κ. τῆς γῆς (see AR, Eph., l.with; for rendering this lower earth, see ICC, Eph, l.with), the lower parts of the earth (cf. Sl 139:15; cf. also MGr., ἡ κάτου γῆ, the underworld, Thumb, MGV, 334): Ef 4:9.†
(AS)

G2738.def:
καῦμα, -τος, τό
(καίω), [in LXX for חֹם, חֹרֶב, etc. ;]
heat: Ap 7:16 16:9.†
(AS)

G2739.def:
καυματίζω
(καῦμα),
to burn or scorch up: with accusative before ἐν πυρί, Ap 16:8. Pass., Mt 13:14, Mc 4:6; before καῦμα μέγα, Ap 16:9.†
(AS)

G2740.def:
καῦσις, -εως, ἡ
(καίω), [in LXX for בָּעַר pi., etc. ;]
burning: Hb 6:8.†
(AS)

G2741.def:
καυσόω, -ῶ
(καῦσος, burning heat, fever),
only in pass.,
__1. to burn with fever (Galen., al.).
__2. In NT, to burn with great heat: 2Pe 3:10 3:12 (V. Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G2742.def:
καύσων, -ωνος, ὁ
(καίω), [in LXX: Gn 31:40 א (חֹרֶב), Is 49:10 (שָׁרָב), Jó 27:21, Os 12:1, (2), Os 13:15, Jn 4:8, Jr 18:17, Eze.17:10 19:12 (קָדִים); Jr 51:1, From Theodotion Dn 3:67) Jdth.8:3, Sir.18:16 34:16 43:22 * ;]
__1. burning heat (Ge, Isa (?), Jth, ll.with, Sir.18:16): Mt 20:12, Lc 12:55 (Tg 1:11, AV).
__2. a hot wind from the east (Heb. קָדִים, see LXX, ll.with), the modern sirocco (see CGT on Am 4:9): Tg 1:11 (RV, the scorching wind; cf. R, mg., the hot wind, Mt, Lk, ll.with).†
(AS)

G2743.def:
καυστηριάζω (Rec. καυτηρ-, and so usually in Gk. writers, see Soph., Lex., see word)
to mark by branding, brand (AV, scar, but see CGT, in l): metaphorically, pass. pf. ptcp., 1Tm 4:2 (cf. καυτήριον, 4Ma.15:22 *).†
(AS)

G2744.def:
καυχάομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX for הָלַל hith., etc. ;]
to boast or glory (in LXX, of joyous exultation, and so in the NT quotations, infr.; cf. DB, ii, 790b; Hort on Tg 1:9): absol., 1Co 1:31 (LXX) 1Co 4:7 13:3, 2Co 10:13 10:17" (LXX) 2Co 11:16 11:18 12:1 12:6, Ef 2:9, Tg 4:16; with accusative of thing(s), 2Co 9:2 11:30; before ἐν (LXX), Rm 2:23 5:3, 1Co 3:21, 2Co 5:12 10:15 11:12 12:5 12:9, Gl 6:13-14 Tg 1:9; ἐν (τ.) θεῷ, Rm 2:17 5:11; ἐν κυρίῳ, 1Co 1:31 (LXX) 2Co 10:17 (LXX); ἐν Χ. Ἰησοῦ, Fp 3:3; before ἐπί with dative, Rm 5:2; περί, with genitive, 2Co 10:8; εἰς, 2Co 10:16; ὑπέρ, with genitive of person(s), 2Co 7:14 12:5; ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, 1Co 1:29 (cf. ἐν, κατα-καυχάομαι).†
(AS)

G2745.def:
καύχημα, -τος, τό
(καυχάομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תְּהִלָּה, תִּפְאָרָה ;]
__1. a boast (Pind.): 2Co 5:12 9:3 (Thayer, see word; e. contra, 2, Ellic., Lft., on Gl 6:4; Lft., Notes, 204, 277).
__2. ground or matter of glorying: Rm 4:2, 1Co 5:6 9:15-16, 2Co 1:14, Gl 6:4, Fp 1:26 2:16, Hb 3:6 (cf. καύχησις).†
(AS)

G2746.def:
καύχησις, -εως, ἡ
(καυχάομαι), [in LXX for תִּפְאָרָה (1Cr 29:13, Eze.16:12, al) ;]
a boasting, glorying: Rm 3:27, 2Co 11:10 11:17, Tg 4:16; before ὑπέρ, 2Co 7:4 8:24; ἐτί, with genitive, 2Co 7:14; ἔχω τὴν κ. ἐν Χρ. Ἰησ., Rm 15:17; στέφανος καυχήσεως (Ez. l.with, al.), 1Ts 2:19; of the cause of glorying, a boast ( = καύχημα), 2Co 1:12.†
(AS)

G2747.def:
Κενχρεαί (Rec. Κεχγ-; ν. WH, App., 150), -ῶν, αἱ,
Cenchreæ, a port of Corinth: At 18:18, Rm 16:1.†
(AS)

G2748.def:
κέδρος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אֶרֶז, Nm 24:6, al.; χειμάρρους τῶν Κέδρων, 2Rs 15:23, 3Ki.15:13 (קִדְרוֹן) ;]
a cedar: χείμαρρος τῶν Κ. (as in 2Sam, 1Ki, ll. with), Jo 18:1 (Rec. Tr., WH, R, mg.; τοῦ Κέδρου, T, WH, mg., see: Κεδρών, and cf. Westc., in l; WH, App., 89 f.; Abbott, JG, 513 ff).†
Κεδρών
(see: κέδρος), ὁ,
indecl.
(in FlJ, genitive -ῶνος; Heb. קִדְרוֹן), [in LXX: 2Rs 15:23, 4Ki.23:6, al. ;]
Cedron (OT, Kidron): χείμαρρος τοῦ Κ., Jo 18:1 (L, Tr., mg., R, txt.; cf. Bl., 10, 5; Lft., Essays, 172 ff).†
(AS)

G2749.def:
κεῖμαι
[in LXX: Jr 24:1 (יָעַד hoph,), al. ;]
used as passive of τίθημι (LS, see word), to be laid, to lie;
__(a) of persons: an infant, Lc 2:12, 16; a dead body, Mt 28:6, Lc 23:53, Jo 20:12;
__(b) of things, to lie, be laid or set, stand: Mt 5:14, Jo 2:6 19:29 20:5-7 21:9, Ap 4:2 21:16; trop., Θεμέλιος, 1Co 3:11; before prep. with accusative, πρός, Mt 3:10, Lc 3:9; εἰς, Lc 12:19; ἐπί, trop., κάλυμμα, 2Co 3:15. Metaphorical, ὁ κόσμος ἐν τ. πονηριῷ κ., 1Jo 5:19; to be laid down, appointed: of law, with dative of person(s), 1Tm 1:9; before εἰς with accusative (of purpose), Lc 2:34, Fp 1:16, 1Ts 3:3
(cf. ἀνά-, συν-ανά-, ἀντί-, ἀπό-, ἐπί-, κατά-, παρά-, περί-, πρό-κειμαι).†
(AS)

G2750.def:
κειρία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: Pv 7:16 (מַרְבַד)* ;]
a vernacular word,
__1 1, a bed-cord (Aristoph., AV., 816; Pr, l.with).
__2. In pl., swathings (cf. Field, Notes, 96 f.): Jo 11:44.†
(AS)

G2751.def:
κείρω
[in LXX chiefly for גָּזַז, Is 53:7, al. ;]
to cut short the hair, shear: a sheep, At 8:32 (Isa, l.with). Mid., to have one's hair cut off, be shorn: absol., 1Co 11:6; τ-. κεφαλήν, At 18:18.†
(AS)

G2752.def:
κέλευσμα, -τος, τό
(κελεύω), [in LXX: Pv 30:27 * ;]
a call, summons, shout of command: 1Ts 4:16 (see M, Th., in l).†
(AS)

G2753.def:
κελεύω
[in LXX: I Et 9:53, Tob.8:18, al., and frequently in 1-4Mac ;]
to urge on, bid by word of mouth, order, command (mostly of one in authority): with accusative and inf. aor., Mt 14:19, 28 18:25 27:64, Lc 18:40, At 4:15 5:34 8:38 22:30 23:10 25:6, 17; with ellipse of accusative, Mt 8:18 14:9 27:58, At 12:19 21:33; with accusative and inf. Pres., At 21:34 22:24 23:3, 35 25:21 27:43; with ellipse of accusative, At 16:22; ptcp. aor., At 25:23.†
SYN.: see: ἐντέλλω (AS)

G2754.def:
κενοδοξία, -ας, ἡ
(κενόδοξος), [in LXX: Wis.14:14, 2Ma.2:15 2Mac 8:10 * ;]
__1. foolish fancy, vain opinion, error (LXX, ll. with).
__2. vain­glory, groundless conceit: Fp 2:3.†
(AS)

G2756.def:
κενός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for רִיק and cognate forms ;]
empty (Gn 37:24, Jz 7:16). Metaphorical,
__(a) empty, vain: λόγοι, Ef 5:6; ἀπάτη, Cl 2:8; κήρυγμα, πίστις, 1Co 15:14;
__(b) vain, fruitless: ἡ χάρις, 1Co 15:10; κόπος, 1Co 15:50; ἡ εἴσοδος, 1Ts 2:1; κενά, At 4:25 (LXX); εἰς κενόν, in vain, to no purpose (Diod., LXX; cl. διὰ κενῆς), 2Co 6:1, Gl 2:2, Fp 2:16, 1Ts 3:5;
__(with) of persons, empty-handed: Mc 12:3, Lc 1:53 20:10-11; vain, Tg 2:20.†
SYN.: μάταιος, of the aim or effect of an action, κ. of its quality (Lft. on Cl. Rom., 1Co., § 7; Tr., Syn., xlix) (AS)

G2757.def:
κενοφωνία, -ας, ἡ
(κενός, φωνέω), [cf. κενολογέω (צָפַף), Is 8:19 * ;]
empty talk, babbling: pl., 1Tm 6:20, 2Tm 2:16.†
(AS)

G2758.def:
κενόω, -ῶ
(κενός, which see), [in LXX: Jr 14:2 15:9 (עָמָל pu.)* ;]
to empty. Metaphorical, to empty, make empty, vain or of no effect: καύχημα, 1Co 9:15; ἑαυτόν, of Christ, Fp 2:7 (v Lft.; ICC, in 1, and esp. Gifford, Incarn., 54 ff.); pass., πίστις, Rm 4:14; ὁ σταυρός, 1Co 1:17; καύχημα, 2Co 9:3†
(AS)

G2759.def:
κέντρον, -ου, τό
(εκντέω, to prick), [in LXX: Pv 26:3 (מֶתֶג), Os 13:14 (קֹטֶב), Os 5:12, Sir.38:25, 4Ma.14:19 * ;]
__1. a sting (4Mac, l.with): Ap 9:10. Metaphorical (as Os 13:14): τ. θανάτου, 1Co 15:55 (LXX), 1Co 15:56,
__2. a goad: pl., At 26:14.†
(AS)

G2760.def:
κεντυρίων, -ωνος, ὁ (Lat. centurio);
a centurion: Mc 15:39, 44-45 (Mt, Lk, use ἑκιτόνταρχος (-ης), q.v).†
(AS)

G2761.def:
κενῶς
adv., [in LXX: Is 49:4 (רִיק)* ;]
in vain, to no purpose: Tg 4:5.†
(AS)

G2762.def:
κεραία (WH, κερέα, see App., 151), -ας, ἠ
(κέρας),
a little horn: of the point or extremity which distinguishes some Heb. letters from others (e.g. ד from ר; DCG, ii, 733), Mt 5:18, Lc 16:17.†
(AS)

G2763G.def:
κεραμεύς, -εως, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX for יָצַר, Sl 2:9, Jr 18:2, al. ;]
a potter: Rm 9:21; ὁ ἀγρὸς τοῦ κ., Mt 27:7, (LXX).†
(AS)

G2763H.def:
κεραμεύς, -εως, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX for יָצַר, Sl 2:9, Jr 18:2, al. ;]
a potter: Rm 9:21; ὁ ἀγρὸς τοῦ κ., Mt 27:7, (LXX).†
(AS)

G2764.def:
κεραμικός, -ή, -όν
(κέραμος), [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:41 (פֶּחָר)* ;]
__1. (cl.) of a potter (e.g. γῆ).
__2. In LXX and NT, = cl., κεραμεοῦς (Plut., κεράμειος, Polyb., -μαῖος, etc), earthen: Ap 2:27.†
(AS)

G2765.def:
κεράμιον, -ου, τό
(κέραμος), [in LXX: Jr 35:5 (גְּבִיעַ), etc. ;]
an earthen vessel, a jar or jug: ὕδατος, Mc 14:13, Lc 22:10.†
(AS)

G2766.def:
κεραμος, -ου, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX: 2Rs 17:28 (יָצַר כְּלִי)* ;]
__1. potter's clay.
__2. an earthen vessel.
__3. a tile: Lc 5:19.†
(AS)

G2767.def:
κεράννυμι
[in LXX for מָסַךְ, Is 5:22, al. ;]
to mix, mingle, chiefly of the diluting of wine: Ap 18:6; by oxymoron, κεκεράσμενος ἄκρατος, Ap 14:10.†
SYN.: μίγνυμι. κ. implies "a mixing of two things, so that they are blended and forma compound, as in wine and water, whereas μ. implies a mixing without such composition, as in two sorts of grain" (LS, see word κρᾶσις) (AS)

G2768.def:
κέρας, -ατος
(pl. not irreg. as in Attic), τό, [in LXX chiefly for קָרַן ;]
a horn: Ap 5:6 12:3 13:1, 11 17:3, 7 17:12, 16; of the projections at the corners of the altar (Êx 29:12, al.): Ap 9:13. Metaphorical, as symbol of strength, κ. σωτηρίας (cf. Sl 18:3, al.): Lc 1:69.†
(AS)

G2769.def:
κεράτιον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of κέρας),
__1. a little horn (Arist.).
__2. In pl. (the fruit of the κερατέα), carob-pods: Lc 15:16.†
(AS)

G2770.def:
κερδαίνω
[in Sm.: Jó 22:3 * ;]
to gain: with accusative, Mt 25:16-17, 20 25:22; τ. κόσμον, Mt 16:26, Mc 8:36, Lc 9:25; absol., to make profit, get gain: Tg 4:13. Metaphorical, with accusative of thing(s), to save oneself from, avoid: At 27:21 (Field, Notes, 145); with accusative of person(s), to gain, win: Mt 18:15, 1Co 9:19-22, Fp 3:8; pass., 1Pe 3:1.†
(AS)

G2771.def:
κέρδος, -εος (-ους), τό
[in Aq.: Eze.27:24; Sm.: Sl 30:10, al. ;]
gain: Fp 1:21 3:7, Tt 1:11.†
(AS)

G2772.def:
κέρμα, -τος, τό
(κείρω),
__1. a slice, hence,
__2. a small coin: pl., Jo 2:15.†
(AS)

G2773.def:
κερματιατής, -οῦ, ὁ
(κερματίζω, to cut small, coin into small money),
a money changer: Jo 2:14.†
(AS)

G2774.def:
κεφάλαιος, -α, -ον
(κεφαλή), [in LXX (-αιον, τό) for רֹאשׁ, Num_4:2, al. ;]
of the head; metaphorically, principal, chief; mostly as subst., κεφάλαιον, τό;
__1. the chief point: Hb 8:1.
__2. the sum total, amount: At 22:28 (other meaning, LS, see word).†
(AS)

G2775.def:
κεφαλιόω (Rec. -αιόω, [so in LXX: Sir.32:8 *]), -ῶ
(κεφάλιον, dimin. of κεφαλή, in late writers)
__1. (-αιόω) to sum up (Thuc., al.).
__2. (In NT, only) to wound on the head: Mc 12:4.†
(AS)

G2776.def:
κεφαλή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX nearly always for רֹאשׁ ;]
the head: Mt 5:35, Mc 6:24, Ap 1:14 9:7, al. mult.; figuratively, ἄνθρακες ἐπὶ τὴν κ., Rm 12:20 (LXX); αἷμι, At 18:6; metaphorically, of a husband, with genitive, 1Co 1:13, Ef 5:23; of Christ, 1Co 11:3, Ef 4:15 5:23, Cl 1:18 2:10, 19; of things, κ. γωνίας, Mt 21:42 (LXX)
(AS)

G2777.def:
κεφαλίς, -ίδος, ἡ
(dimin. of κεφαλή), [in LXX for מְגִלָּה, וָו, etc. ;]
__1. a little head.
__2. an extremity, capital (of a column).
__3. (As in Êx 2:9, Sl 40:8, Et 6:2) a roll: κ. βιβλίου, Hb 10:7 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2778.def:
κῆνσος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. census),
a poll-tax: Mt 17:25 22:17, Mc 12:14 (WH, mg., ἐπικεφάλαιον); τ. νόμισμα τοῦ κ., Mt 22:19 (see MM, Exp., xv).†
(AS)

G2779.def:
κῆπος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for גַּן, גַּנָּה, גִּנָּה, Dt 11:10, Ct 4:12, al. ;]
a garden: Lc 13:19, Jo 18:1, 26 19:41.†
(AS)

G2780.def:
κηπ-ουρός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κῆπος + οὖρος, a watcher)
a gardener: Jo 20:15.†
(AS)

G2781.def:
κηρίον, -ου, τό
(κηρός, wax), [in LXX for נֹפֶת, צוּף, Sl 19:10 118:12, Pv 16:24, al. ;]
honeycomb: κ. μελίσσιον, Lc 24:42 (Rec.; WH, txt., R, txt., omit).†
(AS)

G2782.def:
κήρυγμα, -τος, τό
(κηρύσσω), [in LXX: 2Cr 30:5 (קוֹל), Jn 3:2 (קְרִיאָה), Pv 9:3, I Et 9:3 * ;]
in cl.,
that which is cried by a herald, a proclamation. In NT (see Lft., Notes, 161), of God's heralds, proclamation, message, preaching (i.e. the substance as distinct from the act which would be expressed by † κήρυξις): Mt 12:41, Lc 11:32, 1Co 1:21, 2Tm 4:17, Tt 1:3; with genitive cubic., τὸ κ. μου, 1Co 2:4; ἡμῶν, 1Co 15:14; with genitive obj., Ἰησοῦ Χρ., Rm 16:25.†
(AS)

G2783.def:
κῆρυξ
(κήρ-, T), -υκος, ὁ [in LXX: Dan LXX TH Dn 3:4 (כָּרוֹז), Gn 41:43, Sir.20:15, 4Ma.6:4 * ;]
a herald: 1Tm 2:7, 2Tm 1:11, 2Pe 2:5.†
(AS)

G2784.def:
κηρύσσω
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
to be a herald, to proclaim: Mc 1:45 7:36, Lc 4:18-19" (LXX) (but see Field, Notes, 174) Lc 8:39, Rm 2:21, 1Co 9:27, Gl 5:11, al.; in NT, chiefly of the proclamation of the Gospel, to proclaim, preach: τὸ εὐαγέλιον, Mt 4:23 9:35 24:14 26:13, Mc 1:14 13:10 14:9 16:15, Gl 2:2, Cl 1:23, 1Ts 2:9; before εἰς, Mc 1:39 13:10, Lc 4:44, 1Ts 2:9; ἵνα, Mc 6:12; with inf.. Rm 2:21; κ. Χριστόν, Ἰησοῦν, At 8:5 9:20 19:13, 1Co 1:23 15:12, 2Co 1:19 11:4, Fp 1:15; 1Tm 3:16 (cf. προ-κηρύσσω)
(AS)

G2785.def:
κῆτος, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX: Jn 2:1; Jn 2:10 (דָּג) Gn 1:21 (תַּנִּין), etc. ;]
a huge fish, sea-monster: Mt 12:40 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2787G.def:
κιβωτός, -οῦ, ἡ
[in LXX: Gn 6:1-22 7:1-24 8:1-22 9:1-29 (תֵּבָה), elsewhere, very freq., as Êx 25:9 (10), for אָרוֹן ;]
a wooden box or chest: of Noah's ark, Mt 24:38, Lc 17:27, Hb 11:7, 1Pe 3:20; of the ark of the covenant, Hb 9:4, Ap 11:19.†
(AS)

G2787H.def:
κιβωτός, -οῦ, ἡ
[in LXX: Gn 6:1-22 7:1-24 8:1-22 9:1-29 (תֵּבָה), elsewhere, very freq., as Êx 25:9 (10), for אָרוֹן ;]
a wooden box or chest: of Noah's ark, Mt 24:38, Lc 17:27, Hb 11:7, 1Pe 3:20; of the ark of the covenant, Hb 9:4, Ap 11:19.†
(AS)

G2788.def:
κιθάρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for כִּנּוֹר, frequently in Sl 33:2, al.); and in (Dn 3:5, al.) for קִיתָרֹס, itself a transliteration of κίθαρις, the Homeric form of κ. (cf. CB, Dn., lviii) ;]
a lyre, harp: 1Co 14:7, Ap 5:8 14:2 15:2.†
(AS)

G2789.def:
κιθαρίζω
[in LXX: Is 23:16 (נָגַן pi.)* ;]
to play upon the lyre or harp: 1Co 14:7, Ap 14:2.†
(AS)

G2790.def:
κιθαρ-ωδός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κιθάρα, ἀοιδός, a singer)
one who plays and sings to the lyre, a harper: Ap 14:2 18:22.†
(AS)

G2791.def:
Κιλικία, -ας, ἡ
Cilicia, a province of Asia Minor: At 6:9 15:23, 41 21:39 22:3 23:34 27:5, Gl 1:21.†
(AS)

G2792.def:
κιννάμωμον(Rec. κινάμ-), -υο, τό
(from the Phænician, see LS, see word, and cf. Heb. קִנָּמוֹן)
cinnamon: Ap 18:13.†
(AS)

G2793.def:
κινδυνεύω
(κίνδυνος), [in LXX for יָקֹשׁ ni., etc. ;]
__1. to be daring, to venture.
__2. to be in danger: Lc 8:23, At 19:27, 40, 1Co 15:30.†
(AS)

G2794.def:
κίνδυνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Sl 116:3 (מֵצַר), Sir.3:26, al. ;]
danger, peril: Rm 8:35; pl., 2Co 11:26.†
(AS)

G2795.def:
κινέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נוּעַ hi., רָמַשׂ, etc. ;]
__1. to set in motion, move: Mt 23:4; τ. κεφαλήν (Sl 22:8, al.), Mt 27:39, Mc 15:29; pass. (cf. Gn 7:21), At 17:28.
__2. to remove: Ap 2:5 6:14.
__3. to excite, stir up: At 24:5; pass., At 21:30 (cf. μετα-, συν-κινέω).†
(AS)

G2796.def:
κίνησις, -εως, ἡ
(κινέω), [in LXX: Jó 16:6 (5), (נִיד), al. ;]
a moving: Jo 5:3.†
(AS)

G2798.def:
κλάδος, -ου, ὁ
(κλάω), [in LXX for דָּלִיָּה, כַּף, etc. ;]
a young tender shoot broken off for grafting; then, a branch: Mt 13:32 21:8 24:32, Mc 4:32 13:28, Lc 13:19; metaphorically, of descendants (cf. Sir.40:15), Rm 11:16-19, 21.†
(AS)

G2799.def:
κλαίω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּכָה ;]
of any loud expression of pain or sorrow, esp. for the dead, to weep, lament;
__(a) intrans.: Mc 5:38-39 14:72 (M, Pr., 131) Mc 16:10, Lc 7:13, 32 7:38 8:52, Jo 11:31, 33 16:20 20:11, 13 20:15 At 9:39 21:13, 1Co 7:30, Fp 3:18, Tg 4:9 5:1, Ap 5:5 18:15, 19; πολύ, Ap 5:4; πολλά, At 8:24 (WH, mg.); πικρῶς, Mt 26:75, Lc 22:62; opposite to γελάω, Lc 6:21, 25; χαίρω, Rm 12:15; before ἐπί, with accusative, Lc 19:41 23:28, Ap 18:9;
__(b) trans., with accusative of person(s), to weep or lament for, bewail: Mt 2:18.†
SYN.: see: δακρύω (AS)
